intro.headline: I Paint Vancouvers Most Iconic Spots...
paragraphs: Some might think he’s crazy, and honestly he might be. Sahil Sian is a Plein Air painter from Surrey BC on a mission to paint some of Vancouvers iconic spots completely from life.

In one of his earliest missions, he’s been seen completing a large 24x30 inch painting on False Creek of Science World. He’s also been seen downtown, painting in the heart of Vancouvers busiest streets. If you met him today, he probably handed you this flyer that you’re currently reading right now.

details.title: Join the coolest new thing!
details.body: Every month you will recieve two high quality prints of the paintings I create of Vancouvers coolest places. Club members will also be entered into raffles for original artwork and have a chance to suggest future paintings!
